description: This file implements the control logic for an electronic throttle module, including PID control, PWM management, and external interface functions for hardware and configuration. It includes setup for auto-tuning, console commands, and hardware pin configuration specific to electronic throttle body (ETB) operation.

methods.name: etbThread
methods.description: Main control thread for the electronic throttle, handling PID updates, PWM control, and auto-tuning.

methods.name: setThrottleDutyCycle
methods.description: Manually sets the throttle duty cycle, bypassing PID control.

methods.name: showEthInfo
methods.description: Displays current electronic throttle control parameters and status.

methods.name: setEtbPFactor
methods.description: Sets the proportional factor for PID control.

methods.name: setEtbIFactor
methods.description: Sets the integral factor for PID control.

methods.name: setEtbDFactor
methods.description: Sets the derivative factor for PID control.

methods.name: setEtbOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset for PID control.

methods.name: setDefaultEtbParameters
methods.description: Resets ETA parameters to default values.

methods.name: isETBRestartNeeded
methods.description: Checks if hardware configuration changes require a restart of ETB control.

methods.name: stopETBPins
methods.description: Disables or releases ETB hardware pins.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeElectronicThrottleCallback
methods.description: Handles updates when electronic throttle configuration changes.

methods.name: startETBPins
methods.description: Initializes and starts the PWM and control pins for the electronic throttle.

methods.name: setTempOutput
methods.description: Sets the output for auto-tuning control loop.

methods.name: setAutoPeriod
methods.description: Sets the period for auto-tuning PID parameters.

methods.name: setAutoOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset parameter for auto-tuning PID.

methods.name: initElectronicThrottle
methods.description: Performs initial setup, registers console commands, and launches control thread.

calls: configure PWM and pin initialization functions
